description: Needs a free TronRelic account: calling it makes your app ask the user to sign in, then the call runs. List the published site pages, most recently changed first, as short summaries without the body. Use to see which pages exist or to browse them; use pages-search instead to find pages about a topic. Parameters: page (optional, 1-based, default 1); limit (optional, default 20, at most 50). Returns total (every published page), page, limit, hasMore, and pages[] of { id, slug, title, description, keywords, updatedAt, excerpt }, where excerpt is a short plain-text opening of the body. Pass an id or slug to pages-get to read a page in full. Pages are TronRelic's admin-written site pages (guides, explainers, policies, announcements) served at paths such as /about. These tools return only published pages exactly as visitors see them; drafts and edits waiting for review are never returned. Blog posts are separate and are not pages. Read-only; never changes a page.

limit.description: Pages per call. Default 20, at most 50.

name: pages-list
title: List site pages
